## Installation

```sh
pip install demo-tool
```

Or with [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/):

```sh
uv tool install demo-tool
```

## Usage

Point `demo-tool` at a directory and it prints a summary:

```sh
demo-tool summarize ./data --format table
```

```text
usage: demo-tool [-h] [--format {table,json}] path

Summarize directories.

positional arguments:
  path                  directory to summarize

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {table,json}
```

> [!TIP]
> Use `--format json` to pipe the output into other tools.

<details>
<summary>How the parser is built</summary>

```python
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="demo-tool", description="Summarize directories.")
parser.add_argument("path", help="directory to summarize")
parser.add_argument("--format", choices=["table", "json"], default="table")
```

</details>

### Configuration

`[tool.demo-tool]` in `pyproject.toml`:

| Option | Default |
| --- | --- |
| format | `table` |
| color | true |
| cache.dir | `~/.cache/demo-tool` |
| cache.ttl | `3600` |

Environment variables (`.env.example`):

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DEMO_TOKEN` |  | API token used for uploads |
| `DEMO_PORT` | `8080` | Port for the local preview server |

### Commands

| Command | Entry point |
| --- | --- |
| `demo-tool` | `demo_tool.cli:main` |

Supports Python 3.11 / 3.12 / 3.13.
